checkedAlternates.risk: Potatoes grow underground like carrots and sweet potatoes.
checkedAlternates.resolution: A potato tuber is an underground modified stem with nodes ("eyes", group-4), whereas a sweet potato is a storage root (group-3).

checkedAlternates.risk: Ginger grows underground and is often called ginger root.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Botanically, ginger is a horizontal underground stem called a rhizome (group-4).
